name: gdd
description: The seven skills of Gate-Driven Development (GDD): prepare a project, brief a change, build it through its gates, review it, and harden what slipped through or retire the gate that adds nothing.

interface.shortDescription: Gates your agent has to get through
interface.longDescription: The seven skills of Gate-Driven Development (GDD): prepare a project, brief a change, build it through its gates, review it, and harden what slipped through or retire the gate that adds nothing. They use what your project already has, and one command of their own, the layer gdd, which keeps the order of every change, counts its limits and writes its log: it comes as source and is built in your project.
defaultPrompt: Set GDD up in this project
